# Importing the data
The bank of england exposes URL endpoint that serves custom CSV extract without requirement of authentication. The data can be accessed via the following URL:

| Series Description | Series Code |
|-------------------|-------------|
| 2-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate (75% LTV) | IUMBV34 |
| 5-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate (75% LTV) | IUMBV42 |
| Standard Variable Rate (SVR) | IUMTLMV |
| Official Base Rate | IUDBEDR |


```{python}

```

## Visualize the dataset
```{python}
(
    ggplot(mortgage_rates_df.unpivot(index="date", variable_name="product", value_name="rate").drop_nulls(),
           aes("date", "rate", color="product"))
    + geom_line()
    + labs(y="Rate (%)", title="UK mortgage rates")
    + theme_minimal2()
)
```

```{python}
# check the latest interest rate without any null values
print(mortgage_rates_df.drop_nulls(subset=['fixed_2y', 'fixed_5y', 'standard_variable', 'official_base_rate']))
```
